rules: all 15 actions are always listed; an action without a valid code stays visible and invalid
a code bound to more than one action is a conflict and blocks save
reset proposes the real createDefaultSettings bindings locally; save stays explicit
capture consumes only the next keydown on the focused key button; Escape cancels it
bindings are device/settings state, never profile parameters or learned values

checks.name: action-set
checks.detail: action order and identities match the settings contract

checks.name: default-bound
checks.detail: every default action has a code

checks.name: defaults-unchanged
checks.detail: the default draft is not dirty

checks.name: defaults-cannot-save
checks.detail: save is disabled without a change

checks.name: conflict-both-rows
checks.detail: both actions bound to KeyS are marked

checks.name: conflict-no-intent
checks.detail: clicking a disabled save emits nothing

checks.name: resolved-bindings
checks.detail: the applied bindings are the proposal

checks.name: unsupported-empty
checks.detail: clearing an action leaves an explicit invalid row

checks.name: unsupported-rejected-by-app
checks.detail: the composition root refuses the invalid draft

checks.name: reset-saves-defaults
checks.detail: reset saves the real default binding

checks.name: save-control-version
checks.detail: bindings do not bump the control revision

checks.name: foreign-player-rejected
checks.detail: a draft of another player is refused

checks.name: stale-draft-rejected
checks.detail: a draft read before a store change is refused

checks.name: capture-binding
checks.detail: the captured code becomes the proposal

checks.name: capture-events-prevented
checks.detail: Tab/Enter/Space/code keydowns are prevented and stopped

checks.name: capture-button-listener
checks.detail: only the click listener remains on the key button

checks.name: escape-cancels
checks.detail: Escape cancels capture and keeps the panel

checks.name: panel-listeners
checks.detail: no global or document listener is installed

checks.name: settings-vs-profile
checks.detail: the saved settings expose no profile or learned field
